title.en: Recycling of Wastewater and Solid Waste
Unit 11 Notes — Recycling of Wastewater and Solid Waste
title.gu: યુનિટ 11 Notes — Wastewater Recycling અને Solid Waste

body.en:
Fit-for-purpose approach: characterise the wastewater and decide the intended use, exposure routes and applicable quality standard before selecting treatment. Source control and segregation can reduce treatment demand, but greywater is not automatically pathogen-free.

Examples:

  • Toilet flushing or landscape irrigation: suitably treated, disinfected and monitored water in a separate labelled network, where permitted.
  • Industrial cooling or process water: treatment matched to scaling, corrosion, solids, microbes and the equipment requirements; advanced treatment may be needed.
  • Groundwater recharge or potable reuse: requires advanced treatment, multiple barriers, extensive monitoring and explicit regulatory approval; it cannot be inferred safe from a simple process diagram.

Typical treatment can combine screening, biological treatment, clarification, filtration and disinfection. Membranes or other advanced processes are selected when needed; residuals and reject streams must be managed. Prevent cross-connections and backflow, and monitor use-specific parameters.
body.gu:
Fit-for-purpose અભિગમ: Treatment પસંદ કરતાં પહેલાં wastewater characterise કરો અને intended use, exposure routes તથા લાગુ quality standard નક્કી કરો. Source control અને segregation થી treatment demand ઘટી શકે, પણ greywater આપોઆપ pathogen-free નથી.

ઉદાહરણો:

  • Toilet flushing અથવા landscape irrigation: મંજૂર હોય ત્યાં યોગ્ય treated, disinfected અને monitored water અલગ labelled network માં વાપરો.
  • Industrial cooling અથવા process water: scaling, corrosion, solids, microbes અને equipment requirements મુજબ treatment; advanced treatment જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.
  • Groundwater recharge અથવા potable reuse: advanced treatment, multiple barriers, વિસ્તૃત monitoring અને સ્પષ્ટ regulatory approval જરૂરી છે; ફક્ત સરળ process diagram થી safety સાબિત થતી નથી.

સામાન્ય treatment માં screening, biological treatment, clarification, filtration અને disinfection જોડાય છે. જરૂરી હોય ત્યારે membranes અથવા અન્ય advanced processes પસંદ કરો; residuals અને reject streams નું management કરો. Cross-connections અને backflow અટકાવી use-specific parameters monitor કરો.

h.gu: 11.2 Solid waste ના પ્રકારો અને segregation

body.en:
Major categories:

  • Biodegradable: food and garden waste suitable for controlled composting or biomethanation when uncontaminated.
  • Dry recyclables: paper, cardboard, metals, glass and suitable plastics; keep clean and separate.
  • Domestic hazardous, biomedical and electronic waste: collect separately through authorised channels; do not mix with compostables or burn openly.
  • Inert material and treatment residues: send to an approved facility according to classification.

Segregation at source protects workers and improves resource recovery. Use suitable covered containers, reliable collection and transport, and occupational safeguards. Local rules define categories and producer responsibilities.
body.gu:
મુખ્ય categories:

  • Biodegradable: food અને garden waste; contaminated ન હોય તો controlled composting અથવા biomethanation માટે યોગ્ય.
  • Dry recyclables: paper, cardboard, metals, glass અને યોગ્ય plastics; સ્વચ્છ અને અલગ રાખો.
  • Domestic hazardous, biomedical અને electronic waste: authorised channels દ્વારા અલગ એકત્ર કરો; compostables સાથે ન ભેળવો અને ખુલ્લામાં ન બાળો.
  • Inert material અને treatment residues: classification મુજબ approved facility પર મોકલો.

Source પર segregation workers નું રક્ષણ કરે છે અને resource recovery સુધારે છે. યોગ્ય covered containers, reliable collection અને transport તથા occupational safeguards વાપરો. Local rules categories અને producer responsibilities નક્કી કરે છે.

body.en:
Management hierarchy:

  1. Prevent and reduce waste at source.
  2. Reuse suitable items safely.
  3. Recycle segregated material through authorised recovery.
  4. Compost or digest appropriate organic waste; use products only when quality requirements are met.
  5. Recover energy where technically and environmentally suitable; control emissions and residues.
  6. Place remaining waste in an engineered sanitary landfill with leachate and gas management and monitoring.

Open dumping and uncontrolled burning can pollute air, water and soil. Landfill leachate and methane require control; hazardous waste has separate rules and facilities. Provide PPE, mechanisation and dignity for workers.
body.gu:
Management hierarchy:

  1. Source પર waste prevent અને reduce કરો.
  2. યોગ્ય items સલામત રીતે reuse કરો.
  3. Segregated material ને authorised recovery દ્વારા recycle કરો.
  4. યોગ્ય organic waste compost અથવા digest કરો; quality requirements સંતોષાય ત્યારે જ products વાપરો.
  5. Technically અને environmentally યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં energy recover કરો; emissions અને residues નિયંત્રિત કરો.
  6. બાકી waste ને leachate અને gas management તથા monitoring ધરાવતા engineered sanitary landfill માં મૂકો.

Open dumping અને uncontrolled burning થી air, water અને soil પ્રદૂષિત થઈ શકે. Landfill leachate અને methane નું control જરૂરી છે; hazardous waste માટે અલગ rules અને facilities છે. Workers માટે PPE, mechanisation અને dignity સુનિશ્ચિત કરો.

title.gu: Numerical 11.1 — Wastewater reuse balance ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A plant treats 2 MLD. Of its treated output, 60% is suitable and delivered for non-potable reuse; the rest goes to an approved outlet. Assume treatment output equals 2 MLD.

Step 1. Calculate reuse quantity.

Reuse = 2 × 0.60Reuse = 1.20 MLD

Step 2. Calculate the remaining quantity.

Remaining = 2.00 − 1.20

Final answer:

Reuse = 1.20 MLD and remaining output = 0.80 MLD.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Plant 2 MLD treat કરે છે. Treated output માંથી 60% યોગ્ય હોવાથી non-potable reuse માટે પહોંચે છે; બાકી approved outlet માં જાય છે. Treatment output 2 MLD ધારો.

Step 1. Reuse quantity ગણો.

Reuse = 2 × 0.60Reuse = 1.20 MLD

Step 2. બાકીની quantity ગણો.

Remaining = 2.00 − 1.20

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Reuse = 1.20 MLD અને remaining output = 0.80 MLD.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 11
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 11

name.gu: Reuse અને waste balance ના સંબંધો

body.en:
Use measured quantities and quality-specific acceptance criteria.

Reuse quantity = treated output × reuse fractionRemaining output = treated output − reuse quantityRecovery percentage = recovered quantity / input quantity × 100
body.gu:
